thread:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deployment for service `inference-router` (v2) failing health checks in us-west-2. Automated rollback attempted 2x and failed to converge. Canary at 10% still showing increased 5xx and latency. Auto-rollback disabled for manual intervention. https://internal/insights/ir/2087654321

Ryan (oncall): Ack, taking pager. Which traffic partition? us-west-2 only?

sara: Confirmed: spike in upstream 500s from modelserver containers behind v2. Mem usage borderline then OOMs on some pods. Affected canary pods: inference-router-v2-3, -5, -7. Logs show repeated "java.lang.OutOfMemoryError" from tokenizer lib after `predict()` calls.

mike: I'm seeing the same in metrics. Error rate jumped from 0.2% -> 8% after the canary ramp at 14:02 UTC. Traffic shift is 10% at the moment. Plan: drain canary and flip feature flag `router_canary_v2` -> off. Who can hit the kill-switch?

anya: I can toggle FF. Preparing to flip now. I will also create a temporary block rule if necessary. Notifying support and PM.

leo: Any customer-facing errors yet? Support ingest?

support-bot: 14 new tickets matching "slow response" and "500" in the last 10m. Top examples: acct-231, acct-992. Marked high.

mike: Ok, do the FF flip + manual drain steps. We'll snapshot pod logs and heap dumps first. If drain doesn't reduce errors-> full rollback of canary via infra console.

anya: Flipping feature flag `router_canary_v2` -> OFF (initiated).

deploy-bot: Feature flag change detected by system at 14:08:21 UTC. Traffic shift to stable triggered. Observing connections draining.

sara: Started grabbing heap dumps from failing pods (scp to /analysis/ir-2087654321). Attaching a short log snippet:

```
[2026-03-15T14:03:45Z] ERROR tokenizer.Tokenizer - Failed to allocate buffer
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
  at tokenizer.BufferPool.alloc(BufferPool.java:78)
  at model.Predictor.predict(Predictor.java:203)
  ...
```

mike: Draining looks effective so far. Error rate dropping to 1.1% at 14:10 UTC. Live latency still elevated. I'll kick a smoke test suite once back to <1%.

Ryan (oncall): Handing over to SRE to execute smoke tests and validate. I'll remain on-call until stabilization.

mike: Running smoke test (simple curl against /v1/generate with 10 parallel requests):

```
for i in {1..10}; do curl -sS -X POST https://inference-router.prod/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' & done; wait
```

mike: Smoke results: 200/10 success, median latency 320ms. Error rate now 0.4% (14:12 UTC).

sara: Heap dumps uploaded. Initial diff shows tokenizer upgraded in the v2 image to 1.4.0 which changed buffer allocation logic. Hypothesis: new tokenizer introduces higher transient memory usage at cold start.

leo: Notifying affected customers via status page (we'll say degraded performance for some requests in us-west-2). Support, please surface guidance.

support-bot: Status update published. Tickets reduced to 5 after automated requeues. Temporary workaround: retry the request once - most succeed.

mike: Next steps: keep canary disabled. We'll not re-run full canary until runtime config sets lower heap target or tokenizer revert. Create follow-up issue to re-run canary with smaller ramp (2%) and lower concurrency.

anya: Confirmed kill-switch stayed OFF. Will keep it that way until team sign-off.

incident-bot: Created incident IR-2026-03-15-27 for follow-up postmortem. Paging oncall-owner and eng-runtime.

sara: Assigning root-cause investigation to eng-runtime (sara + mike). Collecting more heap profiles and reproducer.

mike: I'll add alert rule: if region us-west-2 error_rate > 1% for 5m, auto-page SRE. Also document a rollback playbook snippet for tokenizer-related regressions.

Ryan (oncall): Thanks all — leaving monitoring to SRE. If anything spikes, page me. Otherwise I'll close this thread at 14:36 UTC after final check. :white_check_mark:

leo: PM note: customers asked for ETA on fix. I'll coordinate. Keep me posted when we have RCA or a safe re-roll plan.

support-bot: Open tickets trimmed to 3; all customers notified, one enterprise customer requested a direct SLA call, assigned to leo.

mike: Action items recorded: (1) revert tokenizer to 1.3.7 in canary image OR adjust heap limits; (2) add smaller canary ramp and circuit breaker; (3) postmortem in 24h.

sara: Uploading follow-up artifacts to the incident folder and linking from IR doc.

Ryan (oncall): Closing thread for now — handoff complete. :lock:
